mapper.select: SELECT holiday_id, holiday_date, holiday_name, holiday_kind, version_number FROM calendar_holidays WHERE holiday_id = #{holidayId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calendar_holidays (holiday_date, holiday_name, holiday_kind) VALUES (#{holidayDate}, #{holidayName}, #{holidayKind})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM calendar_holidays WHERE holiday_id = #{holidayId} AND version_number = #{versionNumber}
